_README: v1.14.4 (CFG-003 fix) — these are EXPLICITLY DEVELOPMENT-ONLY values. Production startup (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production) fail-fast rejects them via the Program.cs guard at the bottom of the configuration block. For local dev with real credentials, prefer `dotnet user-secrets set Asterisk:Ami:Password <value>` — the user-secrets provider (UserSecretsId is wired in the csproj) takes precedence over this file at runtime.
